title: DECISION CARD  ex19_a3_mes_loss  A3 expiry-Friday short  MES leg  2012-11-16 09:30
decision:
Rule: today 2012-11-16 is the monthly options expiry (Fri 2012-11-16)  ->  SHORT 1 MES at the 09:30 mark 1,352.25,
    cover at the 16:00 mark, no stop
drivers:
Only the calendar decides: no price, trend, VWAP or EMA is read. The trade is the same every month (also on MNQ and MYM); the idea is that option-
    hedging flows that lift prices into the morning settlement fade during the day.
A3 MES leg overall (v3/out/trades/A3.parquet): 181 trades, mean +16.26 $, 54% winners.
outcome:
OUTCOME: cover 1,357.00 at 16:00 -> -27.25 $ per micro after $3.50 costs (-4.75 pts)  =  WRONG.  Whole basket that
    day: -44.75 $
why:
MES rose from 1,352.25 at 09:30 to 1,357.00 at 16:00, so the short lost -27.25 $. Nothing in A3 looks at price, so it cannot avoid such days;
    only about half of expiry days are positive and the profit comes from a few big down days.
notes:
Edge vs an ordinary day: -27.25 $ minus C1 -5.78 $ = -21.47 $ (stored d_c1 -24.48 uses the 999-draw c1 -2.77). Prices recomputed from 1-minute bars and matched to
    sessions_ES.parquet and A3.parquet.

C1 here = exact average over ALL same-year sessions with both prices; the stored c1 is the average of 999 random draws from those sessions, so the two differ by sampling
    noise (harness.py:419-451; early-close days use the last price there, dropped here).
